name: The bargain sealed in blood
summary: Drakuru cuts his palm and reaches through the cage. The meeting becomes a blood pact, binding the two sides to a temporary alliance. He promises knowledge of Drak’Tharon Keep, whose fall has left the borderlands under threat. At Granite Springs, the promise appears to serve a common need: the captive will guide the seeker, and the living may learn what has overtaken the old fortress. The pact gives trust a shape, though not yet a reason to doubt it.
